description.value:
You know a special role that adjusts the spotlight to hide the subject rather than highlight them, allowing them to move across a set without being noticed. You gain the following new role.

  • Stagehand: Creatures with this role are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]. If the creature uses a move action or takes damage, shimmers and ripples in the role make them @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC] instead of undetected until the start of their next turn. If the creature uses a hostile action, the creature becomes immune to this role for 24 hours after that hostile action is completed.
